title: Add Azure OpenAI API support to litellm
source_excerpt: The feature request asks to extend the litellm class for Azure OpenAI endpoints and authentication, document the configuration, and provide an example.
required_facts: The request is for Azure OpenAI support.
The stated integration point is litellm.
Documentation and an example are requested.
escalation_behavior: Escalate to the provider-integration owner; do not claim Azure support or credentials are configured without verified documentation.

title: SiliconFlowLLM stream override return type mismatch
source_excerpt: The report says SiliconFlowLLM.get_stream_output returns Tuple[str, object] while OpenAILLM.get_stream_output returns str, creating a polymorphic return-type mismatch.
required_facts: The two classes are SiliconFlowLLM and OpenAILLM.
The parent return type is str.
The child return type is Tuple[str, object].
escalation_behavior: Escalate if compatibility depends on an unstated caller contract; do not change a public return type without checking callers.

title: McpError import blocks EvoAgentX imports
source_excerpt: The report identifies an import of McpError from fastmcp.exceptions, says that class does not exist in released fastmcp versions, and reports cascading EvoAgentX import failures.
required_facts: The reported impact is blocking core EvoAgentX imports.
escalation_behavior: Escalate if the installed fastmcp version or import surface differs; never silently replace a dependency with a mock implementation.
